items.text: Granlund's status ahead of Friday's clash against the Bruins is in jeopardy following Thursday's injury designation. Granlund's production is rarely flashy, but he's consistent in a top-six role with power-play time, so he can be trusted in fantasy.

items.text: Granlund restored a three-goal lead with his tally in the third period and also helped out on Nikita Nesterenko's empty-netter. The second-line center has added six shots on net, three blocked shots and a plus-1 rating, and two of his points have come with the man advantage.
